title: Independent Engineer's agreements

voice.rule: No voice: the Parties act in the third person (the Agency shall …).

spelling.rule: British -ise (authorised, utilisation, organisation), although the firm's agreement bases still carry -ize: change it as you write.

cross_refs.rule: Articles and Sections in the body, Schedules lettered; the heading in brackets on the first reference in a clause: Section 8.3 (Conciliation), Schedule B (Accounts).

headings.rule: Title Case with every word capitalised, small words too: Grant Of Rights, Deposits & Withdrawals From Accounts. Schedules: Schedule A – [Title].

dates.preamble: on this [●] day of [●] (the Signing Date) at [●], Pakistan

parties_close.text: (the [●], which expression shall, where the context so permits, be deemed to mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns)

rollup.text: (the Government, the Agency and the Concessionaire are hereinafter collectively referred to as the Concession Agreement Parties and each individually as a Concession Agreement Party, as the context may require); … (… are hereinafter collectively referred to as the Parties and each individually as a Party, as the context may require).

recitals_open.text: Recitals / Whereas: then numbered or lettered limbs, the last "And whereas, …"

now_therefore.text: Now, Therefore, in consideration of the mutual covenants herein contained, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, intending to be legally bound, the Parties hereto agree as follows:

testimonium.text: In Witness Whereof the Parties hereto have caused this Agreement to be executed by their duly authorised representatives as of the day, month and year first above written.

execution.text: As [Party] / For and on behalf of [●] through its authorised signatory / Name: / Designation: / in the presence of / Witnesses: / Name: / Address: / CNIC / Passport No:

governing_law.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

arbitration.text: No default: the seat, the rules (Arbitration Act, 1940 or institutional, e.g. SIAC), the number of arbitrators and the venue are always asked as a drafting question; the firm's files differ (a sole arbitrator under the Arbitration Act, 1940; a board of three under the Arbitration Act, 1940; SIAC seated in Singapore).

preamble.text: This Independent Engineer Agreement (this Agreement) is made at [●], Pakistan on this [●] day of [●] (the Signing Date) by and between:

government_party.text: The [●], having his offices at [●] (the Government);

banned.reason: The firm's party clause reads (the [●], which expression shall, where the context so permits, be deemed to mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns), not "(hereinafter referred to as …". The roll-up "are hereinafter collectively referred to as the Parties" is the firm's own.
The pointer reads "shall bear the meaning ascribed thereto in …", without "as".

banned.pattern: \bha(?:s|ve) the meanings? given to (?:it|them|that term|the term|such term)\b
banned.reason: "has the meaning given to it in" is another firm's pointer; the firm writes "shall have (or bear) the meaning ascribed thereto in …".
Figures in brackets are not zero-padded: five (5) days, not five (05) days.

tells_of_counterparty.tell: "has the meaning given to it in" pointers
"(hereinafter referred to as the X which expression shall mean and include …)" with no "where the context so permits"
parties called "the Company" rather than by role (the Concessionaire, the Project Company)
money with the words first: Pakistani Rupees [words] (PKR [●])

defined_terms.pointer_formula: shall bear the meaning ascribed thereto in Section 2.1 (The Appointment)
defined_terms.lead_in: Unless specified otherwise herein, in this Agreement (including the Recitals), all capitalised terms shall have the meanings assigned to them under the Concession Agreement (as defined below). In addition, the following terms shall have the following meanings, unless the context otherwise requires:

notes: Terms of reference and schedules use "will" for what the Independent Engineer does; in the body every obligation takes "shall".
Experience requirements ("10 years") in the terms of reference are figures in a table and stay as they are.
